findings.title: Login-cache invalidation uses organization-aware original model
findings.body: update() obtains the original IDP through getById(), which returns createOrganizationAwareIdentityProviderModel(...). For an IDP linked to a disabled organization (or when the organization provider is unavailable), that wrapper's isEnabled() is false even though the raw persisted IDP is enabled and was therefore cached in the login list. If such an IDP is subsequently updated from enabled=true to enabled=false, registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate sees both the wrapped original and the raw updated model as non-login IDPs and returns without invalidating the login caches. The cached getForLogin result then continues to contain an IDP that is no longer login-eligible until another invalidation happens. The invalidation predicate should be evaluated against the raw stored model, not the organization-aware wrapper.

findings.title: New IDP cleanup uses wrong alias and leaks all created providers
findings.body: testCacheIDPForLogin registers cleanup with testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias") instead of the actual aliases it creates ("idp-alias-" + i, and "idp-alias-20" at line 425). Consequently none of the 21 IDPs created by this test are removed, and cleanup also attempts to delete a provider named "alias" that does not exist. The leaked IDPs can change exact-count assertions in later tests in this class and make reruns order-dependent. Register cleanup with the real alias for each created provider.

findings.title: Create/remove invalidation for login IDPs is not tested
findings.body: The new test only creates an IDP with hideOnLogin=true and removes a disabled IDP, i.e. both operations are for non-login IDPs, and asserts that the login caches remain. It never verifies that creating a login-eligible IDP or removing one actually invalidates the getForLogin caches. The create() and remove() invalidation branches added in this PR could be removed or broken and this test would still pass. Add cases that create an enabled/login-visible IDP and remove one, asserting that all login cache entries are cleared.
